x: Association's 5 miles Handicaps was held on December 16th, and was won by W. H, Rispin, with F.
Had a Camp Sports Day, and won a half-mile walk in 3 m. 40. Frank Jeffries, in the R.A.M.C., and now in Cornwall. " Champ " Smith is now a " full blown " cook at Tidworth.
Also Corporal Dumbrill, who was in the R.E.'s team from Hampshire. Also Frank Jeffries, who was with the R.A.M.C. team, from Hampshire. It was a pity that only four of the " B'. team turned up.
King and F. Jeffries back in training again, after being de-mobbed, and we hope they will soon find their pre-war form.
